title: Neo-Tokyo Cyberpunk 5e Class and Spell Reskin Database

class_reskins.primary_role: Hardware Engineering, Cyberware Fitting, & Drone Crafting
class_reskins.description: Pioneers of sub-dermal hardware, jury-rigged gadgets, and custom bio-drones who modify gear and maintain squad cyberware.
Heavy combatants who trigger sub-dermal adrenaline pumps, muscle fiber overclocks, and dermal armor plating to absorb lethal damage.

class_reskins.primary_role: Social Manipulation, Subliminal Buffs, & Mesh Broadcasting
class_reskins.description: Media influencers, pirate broadcasters, and acoustic manipulators who use subliminal audio frequencies and neural hype tracks to control the battlefield.

class_reskins.primary_role: Combat Triage, Cellular Restoration, & Ley-Line Wards
class_reskins.description: Field medics deploying trauma-surge nanites or traditional Shinto mediums invoking ancient spirit wards against corporate incursions.

class_reskins.primary_role: Awakened Flora/Fauna Control, Bio-Drone Mutagenesis, & Environmental Manipulation
class_reskins.description: Spiritual mediums and geneticists who commune with urban critters, manipulate mutated city flora, and morph into apex bio-drones.

class_reskins.primary_role: Weapon Mastery, Tactical Precision, & Kinetic Combat
class_reskins.description: Elites trained in smart-linked firearms, monomolecular blades, and tactical neural reflex boosters for close-quarters warfare.

class_reskins.primary_role: High-Speed Unarmed Strikes, Reflex Evasion, & Sub-Dermal Qi
class_reskins.description: Martial artists utilizing high-torque servo-limbs, sub-dermal kinetic discharge, and neural speed routines to bypass heavy armor.

class_reskins.primary_role: Frontline Aegis Shielding, Smite Discharges, & Directive Auras
class_reskins.description: Armored enforcers bound by corporate contracts or street codes who channel high-voltage smite bursts through their weapon suites.
Scouts and snipers who track targets across Neo-Tokyo vertical layers using smart-link tags, thermal optics, and scout drones.

class_reskins.primary_role: Stealth Infiltration, Mag-Lock Bypassing, & Critical Glitch Strikes
class_reskins.description: Infiltrators and data thieves who slip past corporate security, bypass mag-locks, and deal lethal precision damage.

class_reskins.primary_role: Innate Mana-Surge, Code Mutation, & Arcane Overclocking
class_reskins.description: Individuals possessing natural spellcasting from Ghost Signal exposure, lab mutations, or raw mana channel overclocks.

class_reskins.primary_role: Eldritch Code Discharges, AI Subroutines, & Patron Exploits
class_reskins.description: Operatives who trade their neural autonomy to rogue AIs, dragon banks, or extra-dimensional corporate boards for dark code abilities.

class_reskins.primary_role: High-Tech Code Scripting, Matrix Warfare, & Prepared Subroutines
class_reskins.description: Master programmers and spell casters who encode complex spell subroutines into cyberdecks, optical arrays, and neural focuses.
